text:
maria: Handoff — I'm primary for the next 8h (09:00-17:00 PST). Samir is secondary. Leaving the quick state: no active P0s, a P2 for delayed embeddings (see runbook), minor alert bursts on grafana dashboard A. If you don't have PD/AWS/Grafana access please call it out now so infra can JIT.

oncall-bot: Handoff checklist: PagerDuty verified, Grafana dashboards linked, Runbooks attached. Add any missing perms to the thread.

jess: Quick Q — what's our PagerDuty escalation policy for primary->secondary? I want to confirm the bridge flow if primary is unreachable.

maria: @jess escalation policy is "redwood-prod-escalation": primary 5m -> secondary 5m -> oncall-leads. Bridge is triggered via the PD web UI or `/pd incident create` in Ops ChatOps. Runbook link: https://redwood.example/runbooks/embeddings-latency.

akshay: heads up — I lost Grafana alerting permissions after last week's audit. I can view dashboards but can't mute/ack alerts or open the alert details that link to logs. I also can't see the AWS CloudWatch logs for the embeddings cluster.

infra-admin: @akshay noted. We can give a 2-hour temporary role. Use the assume-role command below from your dev laptop (MFA required):

```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/OncallTemporary_GrafanaAccess --role-session-name akshay-oncall-2h --duration-seconds 7200
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=...
export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=...
export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=...
```

This role has Grafana viewer+alerting and read-only CloudWatch. Let me know when you run it and I'll escalate if it fails.

akshay: running it now. MFA prompt popped.

incident-bot: NOTE: Previous shift closed incident 3409999999 (embeddings-degraded) at 08:45 PST. Summary: spike in tail-latency due to transient KC cache pressure. Resolved by cache-prefetch toggle. Monitor for recurrence.

maria: Thanks — main things for next shift: 1) watch the embeddings tail-latency metric (grafana panel: /d/abcd/embeddings?orgId=1&panelId=17), 2) PD schedule should be pinned to the prod rotation, 3) if Grafana alerts fire, we follow the embeddings-latency runbook (link above) and open a Slack bridge: #prod-bridge.

jess: For the Bridge — do we use the standard Zoom bridge or call the conference phone? We had confusion last week.

samir: Use Zoom link in the runbook, and paste the PD incident URL into the bridge message. If Zoom fails fallback to phone: +1-650-555-0123. I'll add the phone to the runbook note.

maria: @akshay confirm you have alert mute rights now? Also check you can open the alert's linked logs (CloudWatch).

akshay: I can mute alerts and open the linked CloudWatch log groups. Verified access to Grafana alerting and can ack. Thanks @infra-admin.

infra-admin: Confirmed the temporary role was granted and revoked by time window policy. If you need longer, submit a PR to infra-access for permanent change.

maria: OK — leaving a short play-by-play in case we get paged: 1) acknowledge PD, 2) open Bridge, 3) run the quick diagnostics in runbook step 2 (kv-cache hit rates + GC), 4) if customer impact suspected, run the /pd incident severity update and tag customer-impact. I'll be reachable on phone if needed. Good handoff. :thumbsup:

jess: :eyes: copying notes to my personal runbook. Good handoff.

oncall-bot: Handoff recorded: primary=maria, secondary=samir, pd-rotation=prod, grafana-access=akshay(temporary-granted).

maria: I'm leaving now — ping me for 10m if anything odd. Good luck and thanks.
